mapper.sql: FROM merchant_settlement_entries reversal LEFT JOIN merchant_settlement_entries sale ON sale.source_key=CONCAT('sale:line:',reversal.order_line_id) AND sale.merchant_id=reversal.merchant_id AND sale.order_id=reversal.order_id AND sale.order_line_id=reversal.order_line_id AND sale.kind='MERCHANDISE' LEFT JOIN merchant_settlement_statements origin ON origin.id=sale.statement_id AND origin.merchant_id=reversal.merchant_id WHERE reversal.statement_id=#{statement.id} AND reversal.merchant_id=#{statement.merchantId} AND reversal.kind='REFUND'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count,COALESCE(-SUM(reversal.merchandise+reversal.freight),0) AS amount, COALESCE(-SUM(reversal.commission),0) AS commission_reversed, COUNT(CASE WHEN THEN 1 END) AS prior_count, COALESCE(-SUM(CASE WHEN THEN reversal.merchandise+reversal.freight END),0) AS prior_amount
